rationale: The candidate is visually coherent in multiple views and avoids obvious view-to-view collisions, but its dominant read is still an abstract bent/cantilevered block with a clipped top rather than a clearly programed neighborhood-living mass. The parcel is generally respected, yet the figure mostly sits inside it instead of organizing a convincing public void. The verified access edge is not answered strongly: the ground response appears sealed/indifferent rather than opened into a court, undercut, or entry seam. The stepped/canted upper silhouette has some precedent resonance, but it drifts toward tower/object language and away from the required active street threshold and usable public-space logic. As a result, it fails program_fit_hard_pass despite decent formal legibility.
